name: bookstore-support
input: Cancel order BK-10388, I changed my mind.
output: I apologize for the inconvenience, but unfortunately, your order BK-10388 has shipped and cannot be cancelled. However, you can initiate a return once the book is delivered. To do this, please contact our returns department and we will provide you with a return merchandise authorization (RMA) number. Please note that you will need to return the book in its original condition with all original packaging and accessories included. We will provide a full refund or exchange for a different title, whichever you prefer. If you have any further questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to ask.
